label: PF Backlog 224
title:
Backend: product registry + lifecycle state + metadata/links store (products/

/product.json)
body:
## Problem / why
There is no single record of a product's identity after creation: owner, lifecycle state, launch URL,
docs/sales/support links, versions. The one-stop page (dashboard BI-0147) needs one source.

## Goal & value
One owner module + store `products/<project>/product.json` (single writer; register in store-registry.json)
holding identity + metadata + links, and a DERIVED lifecycle state.

## In scope
- Fields: name, owner, created_at, links{launch, docs, sales, onboarding, support, status},
  versions[], metadata; editable via API (validated).
- Lifecycle state: ideation|designing|building|verifying|built|launching|live|maintaining|on-hold|archived
  DERIVED from pipeline-state + run_quality_gate GO + deploy/observability signals.
- Read API + update API; idempotent; no duplication of backlog/artifact truth.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- product.json is the single writer for identity/links; lifecycle updates as stages progress without manual edits.
- Editing a link persists and validates; nothing else writes this file.

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: lifecycle derivation table (state inputs -> lifecycle); link schema validation; idempotency.

## Links
docs/product-portal.md; dashboard BI-0147/0149.
_note: Implemented: portfolio.register + products/portfolio-registry.json (registry) + core/state_machine (lifecycle) + core/project_store (metadata/sections) + product.json links/versions (product_page.identity).
